statement: The exact conjugate h/hbar joint cubic quotient, its Q3 wild descent with full conjugacy injection and evaluated class-two/class-three fibres, and the integral lower central image of the intrinsic cubic source.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16, folios733v–736v, scans172–178, formulas371–379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: The actual intermediate scheme is the connected degree-three cover v^3=-zeta^2*h^2/(h+zeta) of the four-punctured line. Its rank-seven pro-three subgroup, both filling kernels, and their closed commutator intersection are proved. The joint geometric image consists exactly of pairs with equal ell=X-Y and X(f)+X(g) divisible by3. Both full and truncated kernel maps are retained. Conjugate coherent roots pin the actual cover sheet and give all four wild Hall operators. The involution is factor swap followed by x->x^-1,y->y^-1. The restriction/first-projection map on full Q3 section classes is injective. Its image has four explicit character conditions; gauge x^(H/12) and the exact residual ker(ell) give a continuous inverse. H1(Q3,J1)=Z3^5 x C3. The exact class-two image is L_a(p_u-1)-L_u*p_a=0 mod3, with nonempty fibres Z3^2 x C3. The exact class-three image is the two actual E78 defects divisible by3, with nonempty fibres Z3^4 x C9^2. The descended quotient family has error e^(7(5-N-M)), hence lifts exactly for N+M=2 mod3. Its intrinsic preimages are governed by the exact displayed kernels; no transfer of the separate E78 intrinsic-family assertion over k is assumed. The actual gamma2 pair lattice has Smith(1,3); the actual gamma3 lattice has Smith(1,1,3,3). The intrinsic third-degree image has index9 in the four-dimensional product-central kernel. Actual group words and integer inverses establish these integral comparisons. All coordinates, Frobenius/source transport, representative corrections and full residual conjugators are retained. The remaining arbitrary intrinsic wild obstruction is not declared evaluated.
